## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install nbedev_test in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure nbedev_test package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to nbedev_test
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/schneider-clarify/nbedev_test):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/schneider-clarify/nbedev_test.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/schneider-clarify/nbedev_test)

``` sh
$ conda install -c schneider-clarify nbedev_test
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nbedev_test/)

``` sh
$ pip install nbedev_test
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/schneider-clarify/nbedev_test)’s
[pages](https://schneider-clarify.github.io/nbedev_test/). Additionally
you can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/schneider-clarify/nbedev_test) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nbedev_test/) respectively.
